name: Article 5, § 1, after point b – 137
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (ba) enhance operational cooperation with external partners within the framework of existing procedures and agreements, in a coherent and complementary manner to support civil protection objectives and humanitarian aid and avoid unnecessary duplication.
